selection_independence: Selected after raw-corpus mechanical census and semantic stratification, before observing current parser output. Three named seeds are mandatory; all other witnesses selected from mechanically discovered populations based on Oracle/CR structural distinctiveness.

corpus.gate0_rule: include iff at least one Scryfall legalities value is `legal` or `restricted`
corpus.relationship: uploaded R2 archive is decompressed-content byte-identical to selected operational corpus; gzip container differs by header MTIME

representation_note: Oracle text is NOT duplicated in git. source_coordinates identify face/paragraph and pin SHA-256; exact text is recovered from the pinned corpus. This preserves provenance without committing card corpus bytes.
